info.title: Ancient Calendar Documentation
info.description:
# Ancient Calendar

The **Ancient Calendar** is a RESTful service that exposes information based
on the ancient Egyptian civil calendar, which is one of the oldest
chronological systems in human history. This API computes the current Egyptian
year starting from the historical epoch of 19 July 4236 BCE — the traditional
date marking the start of the Ancient Calendar. It provides valuable information
for educational, cultural, astronomical, and symbolic purposes, as well as for
integration into creative digital projects.

![Ancient Calendar Logo](doc/logo.jpg)

## Overview

The Ancient Calendar system, rooted in ancient Egypt, follows a year of 365
days, with 12 months of 30 days each, plus 5 additional days (known as
"epagomenal days"). This API calculates:

- The **current Egyptian year** (beginning from the year 4236 BCE).
- The **current day of the Egyptian year**.
- The **percentage progress** of the Egyptian year.
- The **corresponding Gregorian date**.

This API allows for quick retrieval of these details, and the calculation is
adjusted for timezone, making it highly flexible for global users.

## Features

- FastAPI with OpenAPI documentation
- Timezone-aware calculations (configurable via environment variable)
- ISO8601 date output
- Easily deployable using the [`demsking/ancient-calendar`](https://hub.docker.com/r/demsking/ancient-calendar)
  Docker image.

## Deployment

### Docker Image

The [`demsking/ancient-calendar`](https://hub.docker.com/r/demsking/ancient-calendar)
Docker image is officially available on Docker Hub, supporting `linux/amd64` platform.
The image is configured to expose port `4241`, which serves the API and documentation
endpoints.

The local documentation can be accessed at `http://localhost:4241/docs` for easy
reference on available endpoints and usage instructions.

### Deploy with Docker

Use the official Docker image [`demsking/ancient-calendar`](https://hub.docker.com/r/demsking/ancient-calendar)
to run Ancient Calendar:

```sh
docker run -d --env-file <path_to_env_file> -p 4241:4241 demsking/ancient-calendar
```

Replace `<path_to_env_file>` with the path to your
[environment variables](#description/environment-variables) file containing the
necessary configurations.

## Environment Variables

When configuring **Ancient Calendar**, several environment variables are used to
control its behavior and connect with external services. Below is a breakdown
of these variables, grouped by their purpose.

### HTTP Configuration

- **HOST**: The host address on which the application will listen. Default is `"127.0.0.1"`.
- **PORT**: The port number on which the application will listen. Default is `4241`.

### API and Logging Configuration

These variables control the API root path, logging behavior, and server settings.

- **ROOT_PATH**:
  Defines the base URL path for all API routes. Defaults to `'/'`.

- **LOG_FILE**:
  Path to the log file for storing application logs. Empty defaults to console.

- **LOG_LEVEL**:
  Controls the verbosity of logs. Options: `'DEBUG'`, `'INFO'`, `'WARNING'`,
  `'ERROR'`, `'CRITICAL'`. Defaults to `'INFO'`.

### Performance Configuration

Settings that control the server's performance.

- **WORKERS**:
  The number of worker processes for handling requests. Defaults to the
  number of CPU cores on the system.

### Timezone Configuration

- **TIMEZONE**:
  The IANA timezone identifier used for all datetime operations. Common values include
  `'UTC'`, `'Africa/Cairo'`, or `'Europe/Paris'`. Defaults to `'UTC'`.

get.description:
Retrieve the Ancient Calendar details for the current date.

This endpoint provides a snapshot of the Ancient Calendar based on the
current date and time. It includes information such as the current day,
month, and year in the Ancient Calendar, as well as the corresponding
Gregorian date. Users can also learn about the current season, zodiac sign,
and other calendar-related details.

By specifying a timezone, users can ensure the calculations reflect their
local time.

parameters.name: timezone

schema.description: The timezone to use for calculating the current Egyptian year.
schema.title: Timezone

parameters.description: The timezone to use for calculating the current Egyptian year.

get.description:
Retrieve server information.

This endpoint provides information about the server, including its
name and version. This is useful for clients to know the server they
are interacting with and to ensure compatibility with the API.

current_egyptian_day.title: Current Egyptian Day
current_egyptian_day.description: The current day of the Egyptian month (1-30).

current_egyptian_month.title: Current Egyptian Month
current_egyptian_month.description: The current month in the Egyptian civil calendar.

current_egyptian_year.title: Current Egyptian Year
current_egyptian_year.description: The year in the Egyptian civil calendar (starting from 4241 BCE).

day_of_year.title: Day Of Year
day_of_year.description: The current day of the Egyptian year (1-365).

total_days_in_year.title: Total Days In Year
total_days_in_year.description: Total days in the Egyptian year (always 365, no leap years).

is_epagomenal_day.title: Is Epagomenal Day
is_epagomenal_day.description: Indicates whether the current day is one of the 5 epagomenal days.

season.title: Season
season.description: The current Egyptian season: Akhet (Inundation), Peret (Emergence), or Shemu (Harvest).

next_egyptian_new_year.title: Next Egyptian New Year
next_egyptian_new_year.description: The date of the next Egyptian New Year in ISO format.

days_until_new_year.title: Days Until New Year
days_until_new_year.description: Number of days remaining until the next Egyptian New Year.

egyptian_zodiac.title: Egyptian Zodiac
egyptian_zodiac.description: The Egyptian zodiac sign associated with the current date.

coptic_date.title: Coptic Date
coptic_date.description: The corresponding date in the Coptic calendar.

weekday.title: Weekday
weekday.description: The weekday name of the corresponding Gregorian date.

solar_event.title: Solar Event
solar_event.description: The solar event closest to the current date (e.g., Equinox, Solstice).

gregorian_date.title: Gregorian Date
gregorian_date.description: The corresponding Gregorian date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

EgyptianCalendarDetails.title: EgyptianCalendarDetails
EgyptianCalendarDetails.description: Details of the Egyptian civil calendar for a given Gregorian date.
